findings.problem: The real-server requirements contradict the defined helper grammar and wire mapping. The helper accepts `-1` but maps it to JSON number `-1`; `"-1"` as a wire value is not a helper input mode, and `-1m` is outside the grammar. Yet completion criterion 7 and increment F require testing all three, while the plan also says malformed keep_alive values are locally refused and raw probes are deferred.
findings.suggestion: Either limit increment F and criterion 7 to wire forms the helper can actually produce, or explicitly add a separately authorized raw-probe path with exact request shapes, recording location, and tests; do not describe `-1m` as a helper-run case.

summary: The plan still has a material contradiction in its real-server keep_alive cases.
